headline: Approved forwarding Policy C6 on home study students to Board for first reading
summary: The committee reviewed Policy C6 on home study student participation and approved sending it to the Board for first reading. It also reviewed Policy C11 on student freedom of expression, getting input from a student newspaper editor, and discussed setting a plan of work at the next meeting.
decisions: Approved forwarding Policy C6 Participation of Home Study Students to the Board for first reading

decision_evidence.quote: The committee reviewed policy C6 Participation of Home Study Students and unanimously approved forwarding this policy to the Board for first reading.

plain_text:
BSD Policy & Governance Committee Meeting Minutes 
Tuesday, September 22, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
Champlain Elementary School - Library 800 Pine Street 
Commissioners Present: Jeff Wick, Chair, Lucia Campriello, Polly Vanderputten 
Staff Present: BSD HR Specialist Kathy Finck, Executive Director of Finance Nate Lavery 
Others Present: Miranda Brown, BHS Senior 
 
 
1. Opening  
1.1 Call meeting to order  
6:14pm  
1.2 Suspend Robert's Rules 
 
2. Public Comment 
None 
 
3. Discussion  
3.1 Policy C6 - Participation of Home Study Students 
The committee reviewed policy C6 Participation of Home Study Students and 
unanimously approved forwarding this policy to the Board for first reading.  
3.2 Policy C11 - Student Freedom of Expression 
Reviewed policy C11 Student Freedom of Expression in School-Sponsored Media. Miranda 
Brown, senior at BHS and editor of the Register, the school newspaper was asked to 
comment on the policy. She stated that she had no problem with the policy and felt that 
the student staff had the agency to pursue tough topics. The committee asked to receive 
the equity tool by Friday, September 25, and may forward this policy to the Board for first 
reading.  
3.3 Committee Work 
The committee discussed the work to be addressed this year and agreed to set an annual 
plan of work at the next meeting. 
 
4. Adjournment 
6:47pm
